mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic contraction, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), higher discount rates and reduced corporate profitability lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units signals weak residential demand, which precedes broader economic slowdown and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 1200.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1% monthly increase) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that increases recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% and rising), the economy approaches peak conditions, leading to reduced equity momentum and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.
